note: Draft register for Spec 062 (successor to Spec 061, design D-27 arm A1 only), opened 2026-10-21 under the owner's amendment-queue commission of the same date (item 3: Spec 061 calibration repair). Conventions as in Specs 032-042: requirement claims carry no falsification test where a gate or inspection is the operative check; boundaries carry the conditions under which each claim holds; evidence items carry observed_at from this draft because the cited facts were verified first-hand at drafting. The AEE lifecycle hooks have NOT run on this register; they are the freeze gate (tasks L4), and any recovery round they force changes claim text before any freeze digest is computed. ASM- ids name the assumptions each claim stands on, carried from Spec 061's register: ASM-PHASE393-RECORD, ASM-PHASE393-MACHINERY, ASM-MARGIN-FAMILY, ASM-SCENARIO-VALUES, ASM-SIMULATION-NOT-DATA, ASM-GATES-BEFORE-OUTCOME, ASM-APPEND-ONLY. The register parallels Spec 061's F061-C01...C15 so the freeze can diff the two claim by claim: the substantive deltas are F062-C05 (the predecessor record is never patched), F062-C07 (gate 0.3 preserved by the repair, with its fencing argument), F062-C12 (the repaired calibration R-1 and gate 0.5-R), F062-C13 (T* on Spec 061's record stays undefined), and F062-C15 (the drafting demonstration establishes nothing about the real corpus).

claims.text: Trial resolution is strict exclusion of the 0.01 margin in the scenario's direction.
